content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The Agreement contains no true audit clause; the only Customer-binding verification right is IBM's reserved right in § 11.3 to investigate potential AUP violations — unlimited in frequency, with no advance notice obligation (the § 11.3 notice attempt covers only access restriction/Content removal and is excused in emergencies) and no cost allocation. That fails the fallback and sits in walk-away territory, so I proposed a single inserted sentence pair after p0137 carrying exactly the three fallback elements (once per year, 15 days' notice, IBM cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%), leaving all existing text verbatim.
